goal: Generalise the candidate from a model API to a worker that may be an agent seat - claude, codex, cursor, devin, antigravity or deepseek - reachable through the existing delegation and capability-bus path. One worker descriptor carries kind, billing mode (a seat is a subscription: zero marginal cost until its cap), rate and concurrency limits, health, capability evidence and cost attribution, and election, ranking, the capability matrix and the budget all treat a worker uniformly. Prove that a seat and a model with the same measured capability are ranked by marginal cost, and that a seat which has reached its cap steps down the ladder rather than being hammered.
title: A candidate may be an agent seat, not only a model
